name: httpant
description: HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3 without I/O, plus an io_uring, kqueue and IORing completion engine behind one interface.

io.description: Build the native I/O engine (module httpant.io): io_uring on Linux, IORing on Windows, kqueue on macOS and the BSDs. Off by default: the library's default identity is sans-I/O.
